strings.Live TUI requires interactive terminal;: 即時 TUI 需要互動式終端機，--help 可確認儀表板存在
strings.TUI dashboard that shows uncommitted, un: 顯示多個 git 儲存庫中未提交、未推送與未發布狀態的 TUI 儀表板。
strings.browse live TUI table with filters, fuzz: 透過篩選、模糊搜尋與詳細歷史檢視瀏覽即時 TUI 表格
strings.download drydock-linux-x86_64 v1.3.1 and: 下載 drydock-linux-x86_64 v1.3.1 並安裝至 ~/.local/bin
strings.filter repos touched recently and find w: 篩選近期異動的儲存庫並找出值得發布的工作
strings.show unpushed commits across every local: 顯示每個本機分支上未推送的提交
strings.used prebuilt linux-x86_64 tarball from: 使用來自 GitHub releases 的預先建置 linux-x86_64 tarball，無需 Rust 工具鏈
strings.view uncommitted and unpushed changes ac: 檢視所有自有儲存庫中未提交與未推送的變更
